reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two separate findings—serrated grain boundaries for high-temperature creep resistance (P2, P5) and Mo addition for strength and corrosion resistance (P9)—and transfers the serration concept to a new alloy system (Mo-modified Cantor HEA) and a new regime (room-temperature creep and ambient corrosion), linking them through a mechanism of strain distribution and reduced galvanic contrast that neither passage states. This goes beyond a simple restatement of prior results.
